name: Microsoft Copilot Free
free_limit: Free web and mobile AI chat for writing, brainstorming, summaries and real-time web answers; Edge page insights. Personal-account sign-in adds chat history, image creation and longer conversations. Free usage is capacity-limited, with no fixed public message quota.
watch_out: Usage limits, features and regional availability vary; Microsoft 365 business Copilot, in-app Office integrations and paid subscriptions are separate. Consumer Free commercial-use rights are not independently confirmed.
